## Make variables

| Variable | Default or values | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `MUMEI_REPO` | `../mumei` | Default sibling Mumei checkout; a Make command-line assignment can override it. |
| `MUMEI_AGENT_REPO` | `../mumei-agent` | Default sibling mumei-agent checkout; a Make command-line assignment can override it. |
| `SCENARIOS` | 18 scenarios: `ownership_transfer`, `rtgs_settlement`, `regtech_compliance`, `nl_to_verified`, `no_mm_audit`, `spec_code_verification_suite`, `mumei_develop_audit`, `smart_contract_audit`, `blockchain_audit`, `medical_device`, `aviation_control`, `merkle_tree_verification`, `defi_invariant`, `arklib_style_audit`, `charter_gate_demo`, `negative_controls_demo`, `test_observation_demo`, `self_correction_demo` | Default sequence used by `demo` and `demo-ci`. |
| `SCALE_SCENARIOS` | 5 scenarios: `medical_device_scale`, `rtgs_settlement_scale`, `regtech_compliance_scale`, `defi_invariant_scale`, `ownership_transfer_scale` | Large-scale scenarios, separate from the default CI sequence. |
| `OPTIONAL_SCENARIOS` | 1 scenarios: `record_execution_demo` | Optional scenarios kept outside the default sequence. |
| `NO_MM_AUDIT_LANGUAGES` | `python`, `rust`, `typescript`, `go` | Languages included by the no-.mm audit target. |

Scenario names and counts reflect the Makefile lists; optional and large-scale scenarios remain outside the default sequence.

## Environment variables

| Variable | Default or fallback | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `CI_FIXTURE_MODE` | Make default: `1`; direct runner: unset | Enables recorded fixtures when exactly `1`; `make demo-ci` always selects fixture mode. |
| `MUMEI_REPO` | `../mumei` sibling checkout | Read from repos.env, then the process environment; otherwise resolves the sibling checkout. |
| `MUMEI_AGENT_REPO` | `../mumei-agent` sibling checkout | Read from repos.env, then the process environment; otherwise resolves the sibling checkout. |
| `MUMEI_LEAN_REPO` | `../mumei-lean` sibling checkout | Read from repos.env, then the process environment; otherwise resolves the sibling checkout. |
| `MUMEI_BIN` | release binary, otherwise debug binary under MUMEI_REPO | Read from repos.env, then the process environment; direct audit options can override it. |
| `MUMEI_AGENT_PYTHON` | agent .venv/bin/python, otherwise python on PATH or the current interpreter | Read from repos.env, then the process environment, before choosing an available Python. |
| `LLM_BASE_URL` | `https://api.openai.com/v1` | OpenAI-compatible endpoint for `scripts/run_llm_only.py` and the LLM arms of `scripts/run_contract_bench.py` (same name as mumei-agent). |
| `LLM_MODEL` | `gpt-4o` | Model reviewed by `scripts/run_llm_only.py`; names the `llm_only/<model>.json` records that `scripts/compare_arms.py` reads. |
| `NL_REQUIREMENTS_FILE` | `spec_text.md` | Read from repos.env, then the process environment; selects the natural-language requirements input. |
